tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

The little star inside Eli goes quiet — and wakes up inside Cheyenne. Eli never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Cheyenne will never be hungry again while it hums, and Eli is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Kira.
📓 Codex: Thornfield split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 3 people under Peter.

Deeper knowledge: Burdock. Uses: starchy root vegetable. Dig first-year plants (no flower stalk). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: first-year roots only — dig deep, peel, cook like carrots; medicine: root tea, traditional blood purifier; fiber: tough stalk fiber for rough cordage.
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table II — 3 people, 26 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They look lean — hungry, even. Food would talk here. They've been here the whole time.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
✨ Ability gained: Harvest Table (L1). Your feasts are rituals. Every feast you host arms the feast surge even without devotion (x1.3 at least), and each guest leaves trusting you a little more.
"THE TABLE IS SET. THE VILLAGE IS ONE ANIMAL. IT IS VERY WELL FED AND IT WOULD LIKE TO HIT SOMETHING."
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.
🧳 Word from The Red Table II: Malik was killed — Andre did it, they say. (The truth: dead is dead; the killing part is gossip.)
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Colton speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
🥣 Tariq of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Tariq waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
